applies: a GavickPro Gavern (gk_*) quickstart: the same site module as the JA families, in the earliest position its layout renders. Gavern has no runtime colour variables: its compiled stylesheets read the slot once tokenized (a JoomlArt re-release), and the slot's own selector rules do the rest
specificity: Rules are prefixed :root×6 (0,6,0): above every template rule, below an element's own inline style.
genericNote: the slot writes no short token names (--bg, --accent…) here; everything reads --ds-c-*
measuredPageNote: the home page is one hero, a logo and a Book a table badge: no paragraph, no link in the content, so its text kinds had no sample under the unified probe (12/10/2026). The News page carries the running text, the content links and the same header; the home page's own heading and logo are measured in the evidence too. Appetit renders no footer on any page (home, Our Story, Menu, Our Chefs, Contact, News checked), so there is no footer kind
readyNote: measured 11/10/2026 on quickstart/gavick-gk-appetit/j6 1.0.0 with its stylesheets tokenized as 1.0.1 ships them (tasks/evidence/ds-contracts-gk-2026-10-11): 12/12, controls 0 differences, no text made less readable than the template's own under the four systems tried, 89%–100% of the page follows; the 1.0.1 build itself (release-batch.mjs build, restored from its zip) measured the same: 12/12; the home page is one hero, a logo and a Book a table badge, so the contrast judged is the heading and the logo; the badge (.btn-special, text on a yellow picture) is kept as the template paints it. The page colours follow only from 1.0.1 (~/tracy-bench-work/RELEASE-DS-GAVICK.sh, not yet uploaded); minVersion keeps 1.0.0 sites out (TEMPLATE_NEEDS_UPDATE). Re-measured 12/10/2026 with the unified probe (fix/ds-reverify-d) on the published 1.0.1: the home page (heading, logo) 12/12, but four of its six text kinds found nothing to read there; measured on the News page (measuredPageNote) with the footer kind dropped: 12/12, controls 0 differences, 98%–100% of the page follows, no text made less readable than the template's own (tasks/evidence/ds-reverify-d-2026-10-12/gk-appetit)
baseNote: painted on the default home page (discover.mjs), then T3 less/variables*.less (colours and faces); border and muted measured as the most painted line / grey text in css/*.css (66 line colours, 119 text colours seen)
